items.translation: 常量字段的名称

items.source: Note that this method assumes that constants are named in accordance with the standard Java convention for constant values (i.e. all uppercase). The supplied namePrefix will be uppercased (in a locale-insensitive fashion) prior to the main logic of this method kicking in.
items.translation: 请注意，此方法假定常量的命名遵循标准 Java 常量值约定（即全大写）。提供的 `namePrefix` 将在本方法主要逻辑执行之前，以不区分区域设置的方式转换为大写。

items.source: Note that this method assumes that constants are named in accordance with the standard Java convention for constant values (i.e. all uppercase). The supplied nameSuffix will be uppercased (in a locale-insensitive fashion) prior to the main logic of this method kicking in.
items.translation: 注意，此方法假定常量的命名遵循标准 Java 常量值约定（即全大写）。提供的 `nameSuffix` 将在本方法主要逻辑执行之前进行不区分大小写的转换（转换为大写）。

items.source: Will return the first match.
items.translation: 将返回第一个匹配项。

items.source: the set of constant names
items.translation: 常量名集合

items.source: Consider class Foo containing public static final int CONSTANT1 = 66; An instance of this class wrapping Foo.class will return the constant value of 66 from its asNumber method given the argument "CONSTANT1".
items.translation: 考虑包含 `public static final int CONSTANT1 = 66;` 的类 Foo。 一个包装了 `Foo.class` 的该类的实例，在给定参数 `"CONSTANT1"` 时，将从其 `asNumber` 方法返回常量值 66。

items.source: All public static final variables will be exposed, whatever their type.
items.translation: 所有public static final 变量都将暴露，无论其类型如何。

items.source:
This class is ideal for use in PropertyEditors, enabling them to
recognize the same names as the constants themselves, and freeing them
from maintaining their own mapping.
items.translation: 该类非常适合在 PropertyEditor 中使用，使其能够识别与常量本身相同的名称，并免除其维护自身映射的需求。

items.source:
Uses a common naming idiom: turning all lower case characters to
upper case, and prepending upper case characters with an underscore.
items.translation: 使用通用的命名惯用法：将所有小写字母转换为大写字母，并在大写字母前添加下划线。

items.source: Return a constant value cast to a Number.
items.translation: 返回一个转换为 Number 类型的常量值。

items.source:
Parse the given String (upper or lower case accepted) and return
the appropriate value if it's the name of a constant field in the
class that we're analyzing.
items.translation: 解析给定的字符串（接受大写或小写），如果它是正在分析类中的常量字段名称，则返回相应的值。

items.source: Return a constant value as a String.
items.translation: 返回一个常量值作为字符串。

items.source: Return the name of the analyzed class.
items.translation: 返回已分析类的名称。

items.source:
Exposes the field cache to subclasses:
a Map from String field name to object value.
items.translation: 向子类暴露字段缓存：一个从字符串字段名到对象值的 Map。

items.source: Return all names of the given group of constants.
items.translation: 返回给定常量组的所有名称。

items.source:
Return all names of the group of constants for the
given bean property name.
items.translation: 返回给定 Bean 属性名对应的常量组的所有名称。

items.source: Return the number of constants exposed.
items.translation: 返回暴露的常量数量。

items.source: Return all values of the given group of constants.
items.translation: 返回给定常量组的所有值。

items.source:
Return all values of the group of constants for the
given bean property name.
items.translation: 返回给定 Bean 属性名对应的常量组的所有值。

items.source: Look up the given value within the given group of constants.
items.translation: 在给定的常量组中查找给定值。

items.source:
Look up the given value within the group of constants for
the given bean property name. Will return the first match.
items.translation: 在给定的 Bean 属性名称的常量组中查找给定值。将返回第一个匹配项。
